edits.new: Use the same materially supported readings of each meaning throughout both directions and canonical consequences. Settle a directional judgment only when full coverage or refutation is established under every such reading. An ambiguous candidate does not leave the judgment unresolved when other valid counterexamples establish refutation under all those readings; different readings may use different counterexamples. General knowledge may clarify language but must not select a convenient scope.
edits.old: General knowledge may clarify language but must not select a convenient scope; materially different supported readings that change coverage leave the affected judgment unresolved.
